# Psalm 132 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA (Council Arbiter) | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A Song of Ascents. Remember, O LORD, in David's favor, all the hardships he endured,

**2** how he swore to the LORD and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob,

**3** "I will not enter my house or get into my bed,

**4** I will not give sleep to my eyes or slumber to my eyelids,

**5** until I find a place for the LORD, a dwelling place for the Mighty One of Jacob."

**6** Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah; we found it in the fields of Jaar.

**7** "Let us go to his dwelling place; let us worship at his footstool!"

**8** Arise, O LORD, and go to your resting place, you and the ark of your might.

**9** Let your priests be clothed with righteousness, and let your saints shout for joy.

**10** For the sake of your servant David, do not turn away the face of your anointed one.

**11** The LORD swore to David a sure oath from which he will not turn back: "One of the sons of your body I will set on your throne.

**12** If your sons keep my covenant and my testimonies that I shall teach them, their sons also forever shall sit on your throne."

**13** For the LORD has chosen Zion; he has desired it for his dwelling place:

**14** "This is my resting place forever; here I will dwell, for I have desired it.

**15** I will abundantly bless her provisions; I will satisfy her poor with bread.

**16** Her priests I will clothe with salvation, and her saints will shout for joy.

**17** There I will make a horn to sprout for David; I have prepared a lamp for my anointed.

**18** His enemies I will clothe with shame, but on him his crown will shine."

---
## Council Notes

SOPHIA detected **6** significant divergence(s) in Psalm 132.

- **132:3** — EMET preserves Hebrew word-order; LOGOS restructures for English clarity; PNEUMA interprets for contemporary application.

- **132:7** — EMET preserves Hebrew word-order; LOGOS restructures for English clarity; PNEUMA interprets for contemporary application.

- **132:9** — EMET preserves Hebrew word-order; LOGOS restructures for English clarity; PNEUMA interprets for contemporary application.

- **132:11** — EMET preserves Hebrew word-order; LOGOS restructures for English clarity; PNEUMA interprets for contemporary application.

- **132:15** — EMET preserves Hebrew word-order; LOGOS restructures for English clarity; PNEUMA interprets for contemporary application.

- **132:17** — EMET preserves Hebrew word-order; LOGOS restructures for English clarity; PNEUMA interprets for contemporary application.

## Translation Notes (Select)

### EMET
- **132:17**: 'I-will-make-sprout a-horn for-David' — tsemach (sprout/branch) — messianic vocabulary; the horn and lamp symbolize the continuation of Davidic rule.

### LOGOS
- **132:11-12**: The Davidic covenant restated with conditions: the unconditional promise (v.11) is paired with conditional consequences (v.12). God's commitment to David's line is unshakeable, but individual generations bear responsibility.

### PNEUMA
- **132:13-14**: God chose a city — and said, 'This is my home forever.' The Creator of the universe picking a postal address is one of the most staggering ideas in the Bible. It's not about geography; it's about commitment.

— SOPHIA
